catalog_metadata.title: Cryptographic Library Policy & EOL Database
target_frameworks: DISA STIG Application Security and Development V5R1
catalog_metadata.description: Authoritative offline database of cryptographic libraries, EOL lifecycles, minimum supported versions, and FIPS 140-3 module validation capability classifications (AOC-09 & SC-13).

openssl.fips_note: OpenSSL 3.x requires an explicitly configured and activated CMVP-validated FIPS provider (e.g., openssl.cnf [fips_sect] activate = 1); library version alone does not prove FIPS mode.
openssl.remediation: Upgrade OpenSSL to >= 3.0.14 LTS (or 3.2+) and configure/activate a CMVP-validated FIPS 140-3 provider for SC-13 workloads.
openssl.aoc: AOC-09: Crypto Dependencies on Unsupported Libraries

pycrypto.description: PyCrypto has been unmaintained since 2013, contains unpatched vulnerabilities, and is not FIPS 140-3 validated.
pycrypto.fips_note: PyCrypto is unmaintained and holds no NIST CMVP FIPS 140 validation.
pycrypto.remediation: Migrate all cryptographic operations to 'cryptography' (pyca/cryptography >= 41.0.0) linked against a CMVP-validated OpenSSL 3 FIPS provider.
pycrypto.aoc: AOC-09: Crypto Dependencies on Unsupported Libraries

pycryptodome.fips_note: PyCryptodome and PyCryptodomex are actively maintained Python packages, but neither holds a NIST CMVP FIPS 140-2/140-3 module validation certificate.
pycryptodome.remediation: For FIPS 140-3 / SC-13 regulated workloads, migrate to 'cryptography' (pyca/cryptography) dynamically linked against a CMVP-validated OpenSSL FIPS provider.
pycryptodome.aoc: AOC-09: Crypto Dependencies on Unsupported Libraries

cryptography.fips_note: Standard PyPI manylinux/macOS/Windows wheels statically bundle a non-validated OpenSSL build. FIPS 140-3 use requires building or dynamically linking against the host platform's CMVP-validated OpenSSL FIPS provider with FIPS mode enabled.
cryptography.remediation: Ensure version >= 41.0.0 (Rust memory-safety bindings) and verify dynamic linkage against a CMVP-validated OpenSSL 3 FIPS provider rather than default static PyPI wheels.
cryptography.aoc: AOC-09: Crypto Dependencies on Unsupported Libraries

bouncycastle.fips_note: Standard Bouncy Castle (bcprov-jdk18on / bcprov-jdk15on) is not FIPS 140 validated; use Bouncy Castle FIPS (bc-fips / bctls-fips) in approved-only mode for SC-13 workloads.
bouncycastle.remediation: Upgrade org.bouncycastle dependencies to >= 1.77, and replace standard bcprov-* with CMVP-validated bc-fips (>= 2.0.0) in approved mode for FIPS 140-3 / SC-13 workloads.
bouncycastle.aoc: AOC-09: Crypto Dependencies on Unsupported Libraries

bouncycastle-fips.fips_note: Bouncy Castle FIPS (bc-fips) holds CMVP FIPS 140-3 validation on 2.0.x (cert #4743; 1.0.2.x cert #3673 moved to Historical status on 2026-09-21) when JVM provider configuration and CryptoServicesRegistrar.setApprovedOnlyMode(true) enforce approved mode.
bouncycastle-fips.remediation: Upgrade bc-fips to >= 2.0.0 (FIPS 140-3 cert #4743) and confirm JVM/application approved-only mode enforcement.
bouncycastle-fips.aoc: AOC-09: Crypto Dependencies on Unsupported Libraries

crypto-js.description: Active development of crypto-js has been discontinued; pure JS crypto lacks constant-time side-channel resistance and has no FIPS 140-3 validation.
crypto-js.fips_note: crypto-js is a pure JavaScript implementation with no NIST CMVP FIPS 140 validation.
crypto-js.remediation: Migrate to Node.js built-in 'node:crypto' (compiled against a FIPS-validated OpenSSL provider) or Web Crypto API (SubtleCrypto).
crypto-js.aoc: AOC-09: Crypto Dependencies on Unsupported Libraries

node-forge.fips_note: Pure-JavaScript node-forge is not a CMVP FIPS 140-3 validated cryptographic module.
node-forge.remediation: Upgrade node-forge >= 1.3.1 to remediate ASN.1 and signature verification bypass CVEs, and migrate SC-13 regulated crypto operations to Node.js 'node:crypto' backed by a FIPS-validated OpenSSL provider.
node-forge.aoc: AOC-09: Crypto Dependencies on Unsupported Libraries

golang-x-crypto.description: Go supplementary cryptography packages outside the Go standard library cryptographic module boundary.
golang-x-crypto.fips_note: Packages under golang.org/x/crypto lie outside the Go Cryptographic Module boundary (GODEBUG=fips140=on / BoringCrypto) and are not FIPS 140-3 validated.
golang-x-crypto.remediation: Update golang.org/x/crypto >= v0.17.0 (mitigating Terrapin SSH CVE-2023-48795), and ensure FIPS-regulated primitives use Go standard library 'crypto/*' with GODEBUG=fips140=only (Go 1.24+) or BoringCrypto rather than golang.org/x/crypto.
golang-x-crypto.aoc: AOC-09: Crypto Dependencies on Unsupported Libraries

rust-ring.fips_note: The 'ring' crate does not hold a NIST CMVP FIPS 140-3 validation certificate.
rust-ring.remediation: For FIPS 140-3 / SC-13 workloads in Rust (including rustls), migrate from 'ring' to 'aws-lc-rs' with the 'fips' Cargo feature enabled.
rust-ring.aoc: AOC-09: Crypto Dependencies on Unsupported Libraries

rust-aws-lc.fips_note: aws-lc-rs links the CMVP-validated AWS-LC FIPS module (cert #4759) only when compiled with the 'fips' feature (aws-lc-fips-sys).
rust-aws-lc.remediation: Enable the 'fips' Cargo feature on aws-lc-rs / rustls and verify tested Operational Environment alignment.
rust-aws-lc.aoc: AOC-09: Crypto Dependencies on Unsupported Libraries

rustcrypto-crates.fips_note: Pure-Rust RustCrypto algorithm crates hold no NIST CMVP FIPS 140-3 validation certificate.
rustcrypto-crates.remediation: Route FIPS-scoped cryptographic operations through 'aws-lc-rs' (with 'fips' feature) or 'openssl' crate linked to an OpenSSL 3 FIPS provider.
rustcrypto-crates.aoc: AOC-09: Crypto Dependencies on Unsupported Libraries

rust-openssl.fips_note: Rust 'openssl' crate delegates to the linked OpenSSL library; avoid 'vendored' builds unless explicitly building and activating the CMVP-validated FIPS provider.
rust-openssl.remediation: Ensure openssl crate >= 0.10.55 dynamically links against a host OpenSSL 3.x installation with the FIPS provider activated.
rust-openssl.aoc: AOC-09: Crypto Dependencies on Unsupported Libraries

dotnet-bouncycastle.fips_note: Standard NuGet BouncyCastle packages are not FIPS 140-3 validated; .NET System.Security.Cryptography delegates to the OS validated module (CNG / OpenSSL FIPS).
dotnet-bouncycastle.remediation: Use .NET built-in System.Security.Cryptography APIs backed by OS FIPS mode (Windows CNG FIPS policy or Linux OpenSSL 3 FIPS provider), or BC-FNA FIPS.
dotnet-bouncycastle.aoc: AOC-09: Crypto Dependencies on Unsupported Libraries
